title: MCA Widens Overseas Listing Rules From 'Equity Shares' To 'Equity Instruments'
case_name: Companies (Listing of Equity Instruments in Permissible Jurisdictions) Amendment Rules, 2026
card_summary: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs notified the Companies (Listing of Equity Instruments in Permissible Jurisdictions) Amendment Rules, 2026 on 3 November 2026, amending the 2024 rules that let eligible unlisted Indian public companies list on permitted exchanges abroad, including GIFT-IFSC. The amendment renames the framework from 'equity shares' to the wider 'equity instruments'.
card_tip: Indian companies, including those with foreign shareholders, planning a direct overseas listing should check whether the wider 'equity instruments' wording changes which securities qualify under the 2024 rules.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: foreign company / HNI (promoters of Indian companies considering a direct overseas listing). TARGET QUERY: can an Indian company list equity instruments other than ordinary shares on a foreign exchange directly. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen. Confirmed from TeamLease RegTech's and CA Club India's reports of the MCA notification dated 3 November 2026 amending the Companies (Listing of equity shares in permissible jurisdictions) Rules, 2024; the official gazette text and any G.S.R. number were not independently opened, so the description rests on these two secondary summaries, which agree on the date, the renaming and the statutory basis.
